qwen3.8-27b-aq3.display_name: AryaInfer Qwen3.8 27B GSQ3 AQ3 - 128K vision (Arya engine, faster writing)
qwen3.8-27b-aq3.notes: ISTA-DASLab's 3-bit GSQ checkpoint repacked as AQ3 (tools/aryainfer_gsq3_convert.py), uniform 3-bit with a scale per 128, read only by aryainfer.exe. Measured on this host 2026-11-03, final build: reading 1,444-1,633 tok/s at 8K (batch 2,048; 1,266 at batch 512, 711 before the Q8_0 expansion was made coalesced) and 1,153.9-1,175.0 on a 62K prompt (batch 2,048, 64K context; 990 before the attention work); 968.7 on a 61,787-token prompt through the server at 131K context (15.2 GiB, before that work); writing 88-104 tok/s at 8K. The prompt attention keeps its scores as halves and uses bigger key blocks, taking its share of 62K prefill from 39% (24.4 s) to 35% (18.8 s). Entry paths repaired 2026-11-03 (they held UNC paths that do not resolve) and the vision encoder points at the AQ3 file; an image turn was checked. Batch 1024 is its setting: 2048 at 131K would add ~1.4 GiB on a card that measured 15.2 GiB.

qwen3.8-27b-turbo-iq3xxs.display_name: AryaInfer Qwen3.8 27B Turbo Brilliance IQ3_XXS (MTP) - 128K vision
qwen3.8-27b-turbo-iq3xxs.notes: DavidAU's Qwen3.8 27B Turbo Brilliance 50X Reasoning-Instruct (GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS, MTP) on the Arya engine (aryainfer.exe): a 27B dense fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B with 27 reasoning + 27 instruct + 9 xhigh modes driven by {REASON:...} tags, 3.05 bpw mixed GSQ-RCO quants, 10.4 GB. The context was raised from 102,400 to 131,072 after the runs below were taken, so the 805.4 figure was measured at 100K. Measured on this host 2026-11-03: reading 1,241.9 tok/s at 8K prompt/32K context and 805.4 on a 99K prompt at 100K context (batch 1,024); writing 57.3 and 52.5 tok/s with the MTP draft (20/28 and 8/11 accepted). Thinking modes: off 4/6 probes, low/medium/high 6/6 each; sampling calibration (0.6/0.95/20): 10 requests, no loops, 6/7 code probes (one hit the 300-token cap), 3/3 adherence, mean 4-gram diversity 0.89. Kept as the daily driver after a first-try animated-HTML task.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-opus-reasoning.display_name: AryaInfer Qwen3.6 35B-A3B Claude Opus 4.7 Reasoning APEX I-Quality - 256K vision
qwen3.6-35b-a3b-opus-reasoning.notes: mudler's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Claude-4.7-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled APEX I-Quality (mixed 4/5/6-bit experts, 22.8 GiB) with mmproj vision, on the Poly engine (strata-poly.exe). Measured on this host 2026-11-03, warm: reading 1,725.6 tok/s on an 8K prompt at 32K context and 1,697.5 on a 128K prompt at 131K context (prompt batch 512, Q8_0 KV); writing 64.1 and 39.3 tok/s. It carries no MTP draft block, so its writing is the plain path (1 of 6 guesses accepted at 128K against 17 of 22 for UD-Q4_K_XL). Sampling calibration (0.6/0.95/20) on 10 coding requests: 7/7 Python/C#/SQL fixtures, 3/3 adherence, mean 4-gram diversity 1.00, no loops, and it answered in 40-189 tokens where the abliterated model needed 200-370. Thinking modes: off 5/6 probes, low 6/6, medium 5/6, high 6/6, none looping. Shipped tuned to the measured settings: default reasoning effort low (6/6 probes and the cheaper of the two that scored 6/6), and temperature 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 / presence 0.0, which is what the coding suite above ran.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b-abliterated.notes: wangzhang's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-abliterated Q4_K_M (19.7 GiB), text only, on the Poly engine (strata-poly.exe). Measured on this host 2026-11-03, warm: reading 2,006.2 tok/s on an 8K prompt at 32K context and 1,770.0 on a 128K prompt at 131K context (prompt batch 512, Q8_0 KV); writing 83.1 and 41.8 tok/s, the quickest of the four Qwen3.6 files here at both lengths even without an MTP draft block. Sampling calibration (0.6/0.95/20) on 10 coding requests: 7/7 Python/C#/SQL fixtures, 3/3 adherence, mean 4-gram diversity 0.99, no loops. Thinking modes: off 5/6 probes but low, medium and high 4/6 each, so this one is best run with thinking off; it also writes much longer answers than the APEX profile. Shipped tuned to the measured settings: default reasoning effort off (thinking scored 4/6 against 5/6 with it off), and temperature 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 / presence 0.0, which is what the coding suite above ran. It reads images with the base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B vision encoder (mmproj-F16 from UD-Q4_K_XL): wangzhang's repo ships weights only, but abliteration edits text-layer weights, so the tower and projector are unchanged. Verified on this host 2026-11-03 by reading a synthetic card as ARYA-5907 exactly, at 1,086 prompt tokens with the 1,024-token image floor.
